baseline_and_long_memory.notes: Same short-task data/seeds/update budget and approximate parameters are stated without claiming all aspects equal. HCSN is substantially slower and does not beat GRU/LIF overall. Stress counts are HCSN 0/18, GRU 0/18, LIF 0/18, Transformer 2/18, total 2/72; no retraining or reselection. Fixed state size is not called long-memory ability; actual KV/HCSN byte counterexample and BPTT exclusions remain.

boundary_and_precision_limits.notes: Boundary center +44.7591 pp and added signed -3.71094 pp are separate prespecified contrasts; altered accumulation, capacity, initial selected checkpoint and stopping-utility counterexamples are disclosed. New precision 2/3 is a scoped engineering AND gate with the Brier failure retained, not universal FP32 qualification.

training_time.notes: Main/baseline and fast/original tables compare complete fit worker launch-through-exit wall. Update-only CPU, test and outer receipts are distinguished. The 177 roster adds only disjoint fit/test child deltas within each campaign and gives no whole-project total.

wsp.notes: The common abs/minmax dictionary and 15-scalar relation head are explicit. Strict compiler takes weights/rules without labels/activations; parent representation remains BP-trained. Supervised ridge is conditional analytic, not strict WSP. Query routing explains old-logit preservation. Eighteen transformed views are controls, not independent seeds. Cold-process costs include loading/features/validation; final test/transfer and unknown rule discovery are explicitly separate. No equal-quality end-to-end BP replacement or total-training speedup is claimed.

historical_joint_seal_chronology.limitation: Observed immutable-run JSON identities and host file mtimes; no claim of cryptographic timestamping. Actual historical scheduling overlapped; final README deliberately serializes fitting and does not claim identical outer timing.
